postconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge_num <= n - 1 for path in paths for edge_num in path[1])

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for path in paths for u, v in [(path[2][0], path[2][1])])

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1 for path in paths for x in [path[3]])
postconditions.description: The distance x for each point is between 0 and 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(any(vertex in path_edges for path_edges in paths) for vertex in range(1, n + 1))

postconditions.expression: all(resi <= resOptimali for i in range(2, n + 1) if res1 == resOptimal1)
postconditions.description: If multiple solutions minimize res1, then res2 is minimized, and so on lexicographically.
